title: Scalix Elite · Live Call Flowchart
notes: Verbatim copy of the Scalix Elite live call flowchart. Center path is Turns 1-7; branches are the objection cards. `raw`/`beats` are the spoken words only (delivery emoji kept, as authored). `anchors` are the opening words of each beat; `objectionAnchors` are the rep-first 2-3 word openers that must switch the card with zero latency.

center.label: Opening & Job Site check
center.raw: [Prospect Name], hi. It's Gagan from Scalix Elite ⬇️. You're not in the middle of a job site right now, are you?
beats: [Prospect Name], hi. It's Gagan from Scalix Elite ⬇️. You're not in the middle of a job site right now, are you?

center.label: On-Site check
center.raw: 🐢 Understood. When do you get all this right? ⏸️ After that, when they say whatever timing, I would say: if it's okay, can I call you at that time 🤔?
beats: 🐢 Understood. When do you get all this right? ⏸️ After that, when they say whatever timing, I would say: if it's okay, can I call you at that time 🤔?

center.label: The Hook & Assumption
center.raw: 🐢 Good ⬇️. ⏸️ ⚡ I'm reaching out, [Prospect Name], because we work with established remodeling firms across Denmark—🐢 to be precise, teams with a strong local reputation ⬇️. ⏸️ We aren't calling to sell leads or pitch generic marketing ⬇️. ⏸️ Looking at your projects, I'm assuming you guys run a core crew of roughly 4 to 8 people on site right now 🤔?

center.label: The Leak & The Offer
center.raw: Got it ⬇️. Yeah, so ⚡ the reason for the call is that at that team size, most firms leak 40,000 to 80,000 DKK in clean gross profit margin simply because high-ticket calls hit voicemail while the crew is on site ⬇️. ⏸️ And that's actually just one of the leaks—there are a couple of other leaks which drain time and revenue ⬇️. ⏸️ ⚡ So we take a look at how you currently run things ⏸️ to find any possible hidden gaps leaking revenue or taking up too much time ⬇️. ⏸️ 🐢 Then, before you invest anything, we identify where AI brings meaningful fixes, and put together a customized plan for how to actually implement it in your business ⬇️. ⏸️ ⚡ And [Prospect Name], before committing to anything, 🐢 I'm just looking to find 10 minutes either tomorrow or later this week, just so you can see what that would even look like for you guys ⬇️.

center.label: Lock the time
center.raw: 🐢 Awesome. When are you naturally more free—mornings or afternoons ⬇️? To be precise, would around 12:30 or 15:30 when you're off tools work better ⬇️?
